Share one link

faq: Is the free plan really free?
Yes. It has no time limit and needs no credit card. You only pay if you choose to upgrade.
What are the limits?
2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels and 1 automation rule, with unlimited email sending. When you reach a limit, you choose whether to upgrade.
Can I use it in my language?
Yes. The dashboard is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian and Dutch.
Do I need technical skills?
No. You build pages from templates with a drag-and-drop editor. No code needed.
How does this site make money?
The buttons are affiliate links. If you ever upgrade to a paid plan, the platform pays me a commission. It costs you nothing extra.
